says: The work kept as steps: the tree doctored, and the brief as a flow and sections with a title as its name; three briefs that decision overtook measured stale
A title is the holon's name in the stores beside this one too: title out of the moulds of document, section and understanding, and the step that keeps it

The roots gathered: 53 loose pieces and five sessions placed in wholes, each source holding what stands upon it and each session its own, the sessions under one holder and the statistics and functions under another; the union listing the roots as they are, and a permission moved to the store of the licence that grants it

This session kept in brief, 12 of its 19 utterances in the author's words with four paths left open; what was said out of the wiki to stand as its own root, the wiki's flow showing its face by pointing; the union let go, since nothing read it
